actions.plain_title: View the email dashboard, triage and drafts
actions.plain_description: Lets the person open the email dashboard, the triage view, the drafts list and search email threads. They can only look.

actions.plain_title: Run AI triage on an email
actions.plain_description: Lets the person ask the assistant to sort a sample email and see how it would be labelled. Nothing is sent to anyone.

actions.plain_title: Prepare a draft reply for review
actions.plain_description: Lets the person or assistant write a draft reply and place it in the drafts folder. A human still has to review and send it.
Lets the person read the list of important senders and trusted contacts that the assistant follows. They cannot change it.
Lets the person see the follow-up tasks that the assistant found in emails and that are waiting for a decision.

actions.plain_title: Approve a task and send it to the project tool
actions.plain_description: Lets the person approve a proposed task. Once approved, the task is created in the connected project tool and visible to the team.
Lets the person turn down a task proposed by the assistant so that it is not created anywhere.
Lets the person link a mailbox account to the platform or renew its sign-in. This gives the platform access to that mailbox.

bundles.title: Inbox user
bundles.summary: Can look at the email dashboard, run triage and prepare draft replies, but cannot approve anything.
bundles.who_its_for: Everyday staff who read and answer email with the assistant

bundles.title: Project lead
bundles.summary: Everything an inbox user can do, plus approving or rejecting tasks that go to the project tool.
bundles.who_its_for: Team leads who decide which email follow-ups become real tasks

bundles.title: Mailbox administrator
bundles.summary: Can connect and re-authorize mailboxes. This gives the platform access to email accounts.
bundles.who_its_for: A small number of trusted administrators who manage mailbox connections
